skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This skill is a local Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment checker that reads a user-provided file, performs deterministic table checks, and does not show network use, persistence, or data modification.

dimensions.detail: The skill requests Read and Bash so the user can run a local Node script against a chosen tax table file. That is proportionate, but users should remember the input may contain sensitive financial data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No dependency installation, remote retrieval, package manager use, or setup-time execution was found. The implementation uses Node standard-library file reads and a bundled local engine.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to running the bundled script with --sample or --input. The script reads only the specified input file, parses JSON or pasted table text, and prints results; no prompt override, hidden agent instruction, or unrelated workflow was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No writes, credential access, environment-variable reads, scheduled tasks, startup hooks, tool wrapping, background workers, or persistence mechanisms were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, metadata, SKILL.md instructions, and bundled Node engine all align around checking a China enterprise income tax adjustment table for arithmetic and consistency issues. The tool is explicit that the free version omits several tax-law limit checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need a local checker for Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables. Review the free-version limitations carefully: it does not perform several tax-law limit checks and should not be treated as complete tax advice or a filing system integration.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: SkillSpector reported partial inspection of scripts/run.mjs references from SKILL.md. Manual inspection found the referenced script present and locally bundled; it loads only the bundled engine and reads the user-specified input file.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language output is expected for this China enterprise income tax adjustment table checker; the metadata includes Chinese names/descriptions and an English description identifying the Chinese tax form.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The comment mentioning full contract text is inconsistent with the tax-table purpose, but the executable behavior treats non-JSON input as plain text and still requires recognizable tax table headers. This is a documentation quality issue, not a security concern.
